rule: Everything under channels/<channel>/versions/<version>/ is private to one install and one version. Everything under shared/ is account-wide on purpose, but a file there is written by one srv version at a time, carries a version a reader can check before it writes, and is declared here. Test builds never see the real shared/. scripts/check-shared-paths.mjs fails when a source file reaches shared/ and is not named by an entry.

entries.name: shared SQLite stores
entries.why: Accounts, bundles, MuxBus credentials, jobs, and the agent-to-account links, memory and cron jobs follow the person across installs and channels (SPEC_IDENTITY_STORE_SPLIT_2026_08_17, SPEC_SHARED_AUTH_ACROSS_CHANNELS_2026_10_03).
entries.gate: user_version (SHARED_STORE_SCHEMA_VERSION, IDENTITY_STORE_SCHEMA_VERSION): a build refuses a newer file (check_schema_compat) before it opens it, and the person is told.
entries.lock: SQLite WAL between srvs of one version; shared/locks/srv-writers keeps a srv of another version out (bootstrap/shared_guard.rs); migrations.lock.db for a migration batch.

entries.name: migrations and their backups
entries.why: A Global migration changes the shared stores once, for every install; a backup is taken first.
entries.gate: Each migration is recorded as applied in the store it changed; the runner reads the user_version of each store before it writes.
entries.lock: migrations.lock.db: BEGIN IMMEDIATE for the whole batch, released by the OS when the holder dies.

entries.name: global transcript store
entries.why: An agent's history is the same from every install and channel (SPEC_AGENT_GLOBAL_PORTABILITY_2026-06-16, invariants G1 and G2).
entries.gate: user_version 2, or 3 once it holds compressed frames; a build older than the SQLite 3.51.3 that wrote it refuses it.
entries.lock: SQLite WAL between srvs of one version; the srv-writers rule for another version; readers/<pid>.json marks which srvs read compressed frames; a reclaim waits for other srvs.

entries.name: agent registry and definitions
entries.why: An agent named or defined in one install exists in every other (cross-channel agent persistence).
entries.gate: None in the files; a srv of another version does not use the folder (the srv-writers rule), so it does not write them.
entries.lock: One JSON file per agent, replaced by atomic rename; srv-writers across versions.

entries.name: live reactive entries, jekt audit and cross-channel delivery
entries.why: A message to an agent reaches it whichever install it runs in; the audit trail is one per machine.
entries.gate: None; entries are ephemeral, one per live channel, and a startup sweep drops what a crashed srv left.
entries.lock: One file per entry; srv-writers across versions.

entries.name: LAN instances
entries.why: Whichever instance holds the discovery port lists the others on the machine as siblings (SPEC_LAN_FLEET_FEED_2026_10_03).
entries.gate: None; one small file per LAN-enabled instance.
entries.lock: One file per instance, removed at exit and swept at start.

entries.name: browser bookmarks, profiles and start page
entries.why: A person's bookmarks and browser profiles are the same in every install.
entries.lock: Written to a temporary file and renamed; srv-writers across versions.

entries.name: layouts and exported workspaces
entries.why: A layout saved in one build is found by every other.
entries.gate: None; the files carry their own format version.
entries.lock: Whole-file writes by one srv at a time.

entries.name: provider logins, native memory and the adoption ledger
entries.why: A provider login and an agent's native memory follow the person: no re-login on upgrade (SPEC_SHARED_AUTH_ACROSS_CHANNELS_2026_10_03).
entries.gate: None of ours; the provider CLI owns the format of its folder.
entries.lock: None beyond the provider's own; srv-writers across versions for what srv writes.

entries.name: CLI installs and the local secrets file
entries.why: A provider CLI is installed once per machine; a headless srv keeps its secrets file beside the shared folder.
entries.gate: Each CLI install is a versioned folder.

entries.name: machine locks
entries.why: Work that must not run twice on one machine (the build slot, a build-cache clean, a MuxBus credential refresh) takes a lock every install can see.
entries.lock: An OS file lock, released when its holder dies.

entries.name: task media
entries.why: A Kanban task's attachments are the same in every install, since the board is.
entries.gate: None; files are named by their SHA-256.
entries.lock: Content-addressed: a second write of the same file is the same file.

entries.name: login shell PATH cache
entries.why: The PATH an interactive login shell builds costs 1-2 s to find, so one cache is reused by every install on the machine while the shell's startup files are unchanged (SPEC_TOOLCHAIN_MANAGER_2026-06-15).
entries.gate: The cache is keyed by a fingerprint of the shell, the inherited PATH and the size and mtime of the startup files, and a miss re-runs the shell.
entries.lock: Written to a temporary file and renamed; a stale or unreadable cache is only a slower start.

entries.name: where the shared folder is
entries.why: These define the path of the folder and its parent; they do no I/O in it.
